reviews.text: Booked 2 appointments 1st appointment they went on holiday without even notifying us and the 2nd appointment we booked for half past 4 then they replied back saying it’s 12pm but it was booked at half 4 for a reason as we couldn’t make it before half 4 waited outside for over an hour these lot are useless WOULD NOT RECOMMENED UNLESS YOU LIKE YOUR TIME WASTED
We've had our wee cat groomed here a few times and the staff are so lovely. Not many places do cats so very grateful to have this nearby.

We take our ragdoll Beans here for a groom every few months and couldn't recommend more for cats !! The ladies who work here are so lovely and Beans always has a great time and they do an absolutely fantastic job!! He always looks very smart and handsome and smells great after a groom!!

This was Ziggy’s first professional groom in 10 years, so I was naturally very nervous about how he would handle it. He usually gets quite anxious during grooming, but the ladies here were absolutely amazing with him. They were incredibly kind, patient, and gentle throughout the entire process. I am so grateful for their care and highly recommend them!

Or dog didn’t get proper haircut at all.  We try this place 1st time because our groomers was busy. I don’t understand where this 5 starts reviews come from. He didn’t even get blow drying and we showed the  staff pictures what we want and get something totally different. We wanted short but they didn’t cut short basically he come out same and probably even worse then he was.  I would not recommend waist of my money.

Very happy with Norman the cat's full groom. He doesn't enjoy a lot of the grooming activities, but the guys at Charlie's were very friendly, gentle and patient with him and he has come back home happy and a lot lighter. Will be bringing him back :)

Took our ragdoll cat Nina for a full groom (this was her second visit)  and we are absolutely delighted with the result as she won’t let us near her ears or nails  so this place is a total Godsend !
The mum and daughter who own this pet grooming parlour are fantastic they are so professional and caring with her  and she loves it
Can’t recommend this place enough!
Lynne Gough

Excellent grooming service from start to finish. The team are knowledgeable, attentive and genuinely care about the wellbeing of every pet. The results were outstanding, and we'll definitely be returning.

Elliot loves the ladies at Charlie’s and they take special
Care of him 🤩🤩 thanks you so much xx …

Not good for long haired cats, probably better for dogs

But the staff were really nice though

A massive thank you to Charlie and Lisa for making Vinny look so handsome.
This is a beautiful clean shop and the staff know exactly what they're doing.
I'm very pleased with the service and price.
Thank you see you and magic soon
Perfect de shed for my Bernese mountain dog! She feels soooo much lighter! She’s nervous and the team were lovely with her. Excellent prices. Very happy would recommend.

Thank you so much for another perfect groom. Oti is very comfortable going in to see the girls and they make her very relaxed.  We can honestly say the girls give our girl the best groom ever, from hand stripping to full groom she has never looked better. Totally top class groomers, the best in the whole city. Oti will miss you both 🐾 🐶 xx

Absolutely fantastic professional service from these two ladies. I had to.take my cat for a.lion cut as he was in terrible condition these ladies were very understanding and did not judge my situation and worked their majic and done wonderful job. I can't thank them enough for their expertise.thank you ladies from. The bottom of my heart.xx

Perfect paws are wonderful. They groomed my 2 cats and after being brushed and groomed, I've never seen my boys (cats) as happy.  I never thought my boys would let anyone near them....perfect paws are miracle workers and the staff are so nice.

My cat, Shadow,  went in for a grooming,  was returned with lots of loose fur and clumps of matted fur,, had to give him a thorough brushing down,,, paid £65... for shoddy work,, will not be going back...

I took my cat Saturn to her first ever professional grooming appointment with Charlie’s Perfect Paws, and I am absolutely delighted with their dedication and skill. The ladies were warm and welcoming from the moment we arrived, and they handled Saturn with such care and gentleness - this meant a lot to me as I was worried she would be anxious due to not being in a setting like that before.

They trimmed her down and gave her the softest, cleanest coat to take home with her ;) I would recommend these ladies to anyone seeking professional and dedicated groomers for their fur baby!
My very anxious chow chow comes out so much lighter and fresh absolutely brilliant groomers and tidy up staff so patient with him and friendly.

First of all, the Mother and Daughter duo makes this place so special and I’m delighted to support a family run business! These wonderful ladies did my Maltese puppy’s first cut and after doing such a good job, they will be the only pair trusted to cut him from now on. Their attention to detail is superb, obviously he is gorgeous before and after… but he’s gone from a wee tramp to a handsome wee man!

More than that, they are clearly such genuine animal lovers and whisperers. I walked in to pick him up and my wee baby was fast asleep and being cuddled, wrapped in a blanket.

I loved how they took photos for me and would recommend them in a heartbeat.

They even gave the baby a wee blanket toy which he loves 🩵

Thank you so much! We can’t wait to see you again x
Our scraggly pooch had the best grooming she’s ever had today.  She was really nervous but was looked after so well.  We will definitely be back.❤️. I would highly recommend🐶 …
My boy was in need of a major haircut this is his 2nd time going to charlies perfect paws the women treat him lovely and give him all the attention and he's very happy with his hair cut thank you!

Took my wee cat to get groomed today the staff did an amazing job were friendly and sparky loved them an amazing job would recommend them 100% wouldn't go anywhere else sparky was totally chilled and loved his groomers thank you so much xxx
Charlie provides a brilliant service - she always gives my dog exactly the haircut I've asked for and puts her at ease.

I highly recommend charlies perfect paws! Jazz and Jock, two older cats, were matted and in need of professional grooming. The staff were so gentle and considerate of the cat's needs. I returned to pick them up and they were happily eating and running around as if they owned the place! I cannot thank the team enough for taking care of Granny's cats and giving them the purrfect makeover! I didn't take before pictures but here are the post grooming and clipping shots. Thank you and see you again soon!

These ladies are wonderful at what they do. Truly a godsend for cat grooming in the city. They treated my wee persian cat miss babs with such care, like a day at the spa, she was so relaxed. Removed mats while keeping and caring for her fur, she’s so soft. Gave her a bath and clipped nails too. Miss babs gets a teddy cut in the summer which they also do an amazing job on and reasonably priced. Thank you both 💗

Took our kitten Dionysus for his very first grooming session and found this place like haven for him. Having no hesitation to recommend has found the staff and service very nice and friendly. Love you Charlie’s Perfect Paws 🐾❤️ …
Lovely staff and made a great job of my girl; exactly what i wanted.
thank you x
